asset.name: AppNavigation
asset.description: The single navigation model presented as a sidebar, header navigation, rail, or bottom bar depending on viewport, owning the transformations between those presentations rather than leaving them to each page.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, radius, and layer order resolve to declared ramps.
Presentation selection is a behavioral breakpoint, not a style one.

suggests.reason: A rail suits icon-first workspaces but is redundant where a collapsible sidebar already exists.
A launcher dock fits command-display surfaces and is out of place in dense operational applications.

rationale: The composed asset decided in the navigation question: sidebar, header nav, and bottom nav are presentations of one model, so the DESIGN.md transformations are asserted here as machine claims. A floor could check each surface in isolation but could never assert that this sidebar becomes that drawer, which is the part that actually breaks.
